conceptBreakdown.heading: Examination Guidelines & Scoring Schema
conceptBreakdown.title: Examination Guidelines & Scoring Schema
conceptBreakdown.content:
• **Single-Choice Questions (MCQ)**: Each question carries **+4 marks** for the correct option and **-1 mark** for an incorrect choice.
• **Multiple-Choice Questions (MSQ)**: Each question carries **+4 marks** when ALL correct options and NO incorrect options are chosen. No negative marking is applied for MSQs.

Pay close attention to ploidy levels (haploid endosperm in gymnosperms vs triploid in angiosperms), algal life cycle exceptions (*Fucus* diplontic, *Ectocarpus* haplodiplontic), and seed habit precursors in *Selaginella*.
